_editorial: HAND-AUTHORED STUB. Same record shape as running-hub.json, with unresearched fields left null rather than guessed. It renders as a row in the register and has no detail page until it is filled in.
title: Secure cycle parking at Invalides
summary: Secure, covered cycle parking around the Esplanade des Invalides and its transport interchange.

problem.statement: The Invalides interchange combines métro, RER and bus with heavy cycle traffic, and secure parking there is limited.
problem.evidence_available: None collected yet. Existing stand capacity has not been counted.

location.note: Esplanade des Invalides and the streets around the interchange. Part of the esplanade is state land, which would change the approval chain.

elu.delegation: propreté, environnement, espaces verts et mobilité
secondary_delegations: Sécurité et tranquillité publiques, gestion de l'espace public et correspondant Défense
elu.why_no_name: The élus dataset predates the March 2026 elections and no holder is named until the mairie site is checked.

direction.likely: Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements
direction.basis: Street-sited mobility work in the 7e has gone to this Direction, but the relevant thematique sample is small. Treat it as a starting point.

conseil_de_quartier.why: The site sits in this quartier.

evidence_limits: Cycle counter data near the site measures traffic, not unmet parking demand, and would be labelled a proxy if used.
Existing capacity at the interchange has not been counted.
open_questions: How much secure cycle parking already exists around the interchange?
Which parts of the esplanade are city land and which are state land?

status_log.detail: Added to the register as a stub so it is tracked rather than forgotten. No research, no cost, no routing decision.
